residual_risks: assert_healthy's health signal is derived from reconcile()'s own repaired count, since RecoveryPort exposes no side-effect-free read-only count as part of the sealed contract; the first health check after a real corruption is therefore always both the detector AND the repair in one pass -- a caller wanting a true non-mutating pre-flight probe would need a new sealed port extension, out of this task's scope, which deliberately stays within RecoveryPort's existing surface.

The real advisory lock is session-scoped per connection (pg_advisory_lock/pg_advisory_unlock), held only for the duration of each recovery pass or claim-deliver cycle; it does not span across separate calls, so a caller must still call run_recovery_pass/claim_and_deliver as often as its own operational cadence requires -- this coordinator provides serialization per call, not a standing leader election across a service's whole lifetime.

claim_and_deliver's lost-ACK guarantee (no duplicate canonical effect) depends entirely on the caller's own deliver callback being genuinely idempotent by event_id; this coordinator enforces single-writer claiming discipline but does not and cannot enforce idempotency inside an arbitrary caller-supplied sink -- this matches the standard at-least-once outbox contract already established by OCOR-DEV-0029/0031's own sinks.
